### Changed
- **The kagent line moves to `v0.11.0-gs.16`: context compaction in the Go ADK runtime and `spec.context.compaction` on the AgentTemplate** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37792). After prompt caching (4.16.0) the remaining cost of a long agent turn was the model's first pass over *new* tokens: every tool result stayed in the history verbatim and every later model call of the turn re-read it — on gazelle the status question's ten calls grew from 6 k to 62 k input tokens, waited 9.2 s for the first token after 16 k new tool-result tokens and 18.8 s after 21.9 k, model time 59 s of the turn's 68 s. kagent `0.11.0-gs.16` carries kagent-dev/kagent#2790 (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#41): `google.golang.org/adk/v2` v2.3.0 with its native `session/compaction`, `spec.context.compaction` on the v1alpha3 AgentTemplate CRD (`tokenThreshold` / `eventRetentionSize` for tail retention inside a turn, `compactionInterval` / `overlapSize` for a sliding window over turns, an optional `summarizer.modelConfig` + `promptTemplate`, CEL for the half configurations), the kagent compiler writing it into `config.json` and the Go runtime handing it to the ADK runner (`context compaction enabled …` in the actor's startup log). `components.kagent` / `components.kagent-crds` move to `>=0.11.0-gs.16 <0.11.1-0`: the floor, because the platform's agent chart (giantswarm/agent 1.3.0) renders a compaction default on every platform agent — tail retention at 24 000 prompt tokens keeping the last four events, the summaries on the agent's own model — and an older CRD would prune the field at admission, leaving every long turn re-reading its whole history in silence. The meta chart renders no AgentTemplate itself; the default and its knobs (`context.compaction.*`, `enabled: false` to opt out) live in the agent chart, which every agent HelmRelease follows on range `1.x`. `tests/verify-kagent-crds.py` validates the connectivity chart's kagent objects against the gs.16 CRDs; the BOM example and `tests/verify-components.py` follow the pin. **Every installation rolls kagent once** (the controller, then the platform Harness recompiles every admitted AgentTemplate; about 20 s per template) and, once the agent chart release is admitted, every agent recompiles once more with its `spec.context` — UPGRADE.md.
